summary: Scoped review of office package gifts: admin-only creation and package writes, preserved owner pending-request permissions, atomic office/subscription/notification commit. Six emulator authorization tests passed. This is not an audit of the entire rules file.

findings.issue: Existing owner-created pending requests still contain client-provided package prices and limits; the existing approval flow should independently validate these against subscription_packages.
findings.recommendation: In a separate hardening change, re-read authoritative package data during ordinary subscription approval.

findings.issue: Existing notifications create permission permits any signed-in user to write notification text. Gift creation itself is guarded by admin authorization and subscription/office rules.
findings.recommendation: Review notification creation permissions separately without disrupting current chat and office notification flows.

validated: Admin status is read from users/{uid}, not request payload.
Non-admin owners cannot create active subscriptions or pending gifts carrying giftedBy/giftedAt.
Owners can still create ordinary pending requests for their own office only.
Owners cannot update pending requests into active subscriptions.
Subscription packages are readable by signed-in users and writable only by admins.
Office entitlements, gift subscription, and owner notification commit atomically.
Foreign users cannot read the owner gift notification.
Office subscription pointer prevents concurrent or repeated gift grants from the same preview.
No live gift, notification, or rules deployment performed.
